description: Creates a new milestone in a GitLab project. Milestones track progress towards a goal with a start date, due date, and associated issues. Use this action when you need to establish a new project milestone for organizing work, tracking release schedules, or planning sprints.

due_date.description: The due date of the milestone in YYYY-MM-DD format.
due_date.title: Due Date

id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project (e.g., '12345' or 'my-group/my-project').
id.title: Id

start_date.description: The start date of the milestone in YYYY-MM-DD format.
start_date.title: Start Date

name: create_milestone

created_at.description: Timestamp when the milestone was created.
created_at.title: Created At

due_date.description: The due date of the milestone.
due_date.title: Due Date

expired.description: Indicates whether the milestone has expired.
expired.title: Expired

iid.description: The internal ID of the milestone.
iid.title: Iid

project_id.description: The ID of the project the milestone belongs to.
project_id.title: Project Id

start_date.description: The start date of the milestone.
start_date.title: Start Date

state.description: The state of the milestone (e.g., active, closed).
